title: Worker seed descriptor
description: Contract C8. The prompt a dispatched worker is seeded with, described before it is rendered. Frozen: the five section ids, their order and the rendered line cap. The wording of a section is free and additive, so a descriptor gains keys but never loses a section.

section.description: The closed set of section ids. A seed carries each one exactly once, in this order.

section_marker.description: The machine-readable line that opens a section in the rendered prompt. It is what makes the structure testable without freezing the prose under it.

line_cap.description: The rendered prompt is capped at this many lines. A descriptor that would render longer is refused, never truncated.

seed.description: One seed descriptor: a pure function of the dispatch envelope, so it is golden-testable before it is rendered.

sections.description: The five sections, in the frozen order. Fewer or more is not a seed.

lines.description: The rendered body of the section, one entry per line.
